description: This file defines the GLToolbox class with utility methods for OpenGL ES 2.0 operations, including shader compilation, program creation, error checking, and texture parameter initialization.

classes.name: GLToolbox
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling OpenGL shader and program operations, error checking, and texture parameter setup.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of given type with the provided source code, throws RuntimeException if compilation fails.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates a shader program from vertex and fragment shader sources, linking them successfully or throwing exceptions upon failure.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws RuntimeException if any are detected.

methods.name: initTexParams
methods.description: Initializes common texture parameters for 2D textures to facilitate linear filtering and clamped edge wrapping.
